sentences.en: Conclusion: Delayed debridement or distal partial pancreatectomy with peritoneal lavage and early nutritional support may reduce mortality of necrotizing pancreatitis in children.

sentences.en: Also, few centers perform pancreatectomy for nonmalignant disease because of problems with fragile diabetes, especially in alcoholics.
